text: Jordan spent Sunday on chores and errands—cleaning up before Mom's visit, submitting a maintenance request for the ceiling stain, and making a big pot of soup while Pepper hovered nearby. The lease renewal ($150 increase, due September 15) sat unopened for a month and was avoided again, and a restless hour of scrolling job listings left Jordan feeling discouraged but not ready to act. No real decisions were made; Jordan went to bed early, already dreading Monday.
